## Problem

A clear description of the problem you are trying to solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when …"

## Privacy check

Soothe is fully on-device. Does this feature require a backend, an account, or sending data off-device?

- [ ] No, it can be implemented locally
- [ ] Yes, it would need a server / account (please explain why it's still worth it)
